briefing.headline: SLS rockets 10.6% as other mega‑caps modestly advance
briefing.summary: All ten core mega‑cap tech tokens posted gains, with nine advancers and only MSFT marginally down, indicating broad risk‑on sentiment. The rise was modest, averaging about 0.6% across the core set, while non‑core names showed mixed extremes, led by SLS (+10.6%) and AAOX (+4.5%) on the upside and ARDT (-20.8%) on the downside. Breadth was narrow, driven by core tech strength rather than any single catalyst. Overall, the overnight move suggests investors are positioning positively ahead of the US open.
